subject: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance for AtlasCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mary Santos <m.santos@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance for AtlasCloud onboarding

Hi Mary —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off procurement for AtlasCloud. To make the vendor setup and PO path as smooth as possible, can you confirm the following so we can pre-populate our systems and avoid back-and-forth once contract/legal signoff is complete?

Quick asks (can you reply inline):
- Legal entity name to appear on the PO (exact punctuation/capitalization)
- Billing address and preferred invoice email
- Tax ID / EIN (or W-9) and whether you have ACH banking details ready
- Do you require a specific PO-to-invoice referencing format (e.g., "PO#-LineItem SKU")?
- Required PO line-item fields from your side (we typically include SKU, description, qty, unit price, start/end dates, department/cost center) — any additional mandatory fields?
- Any special terms that must be called out on the PO (data residency, encryption, PSV, etc.)
- Typical PO issuance lead time once vendor paperwork is fully submitted (target for Redwood: 3–5 business days if possible)
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly / quarterly / milestone) and payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.)

If you already have a vendor intake form or sample PO template please attach — we’ll use it to create the initial PO draft. I’ve CC'd Dev (vendor ops) and Marcus (billing) to keep ops aligned.

Goal: have a completed vendor form + W-9 and a pre-populated PO draft so procurement can issue within our target window. Could you get the details back by end of day Thursday (10/22)? If not, propose a date that works.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (placeholder), sample_po_template.xlsx (placeholder)
From: Mary Santos <m.santos@atlascloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AtlasCloud Procurement <procurement@atlascloud.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance for AtlasCloud onboarding

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Answers inline below, and I’ve attached our vendor intake form and a sample PO for reference.

- Legal entity: AtlasCloud, Inc. (exact)
- Billing address: 1800 Seaport Ave, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02127
- Invoice email: accounts@atlascloud.com (please CC procurement@atlascloud.com)
- Tax/EIN: 04-1234567 — we will attach a completed W-9 with the vendor form
- Bank info: ACH details available on signed vendor form (we’ll provide routing/account for Redwood to set up ACH)
- PO-to-invoice reference: include the exact PO number and the invoice line reference; "PO#" must appear on each invoice line
- Mandatory line-item fields: SKU, description (<=140 chars), qty, unit price, total, start date, end date, cost center (free-text), and a "Contract Item ID" field — we can accept additional custom fields as metadata
- Special terms: Data processing addendum executed as part of SOW (no additional PO annotation required)
- Typical issuance lead time: for new vendors after paperwork is complete we usually see POs issued within 7–10 business days on our side; expedited for prioritized partners
- Billing cadence: Monthly invoices; payment terms Net30

We prefer the vendor form completed and returned before the PO is issued. Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_po_template.xlsx

Would you like to schedule a short call tomorrow to review a pre-populated PO? Happy to do 30 minutes.

Best,
Mary Santos
VP, Finance Operations | AtlasCloud, Inc.
m.santos@atlascloud.com | +1 617-555-4466

Attachment stubs: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_po_template.xlsx
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mary Santos <m.santos@atlascloud.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance for AtlasCloud onboarding

Mary — thanks for the quick response and the attachments. Two operational clarifications from procurement/vendor-ops and billing so we can avoid rework: 

1) Redwood target SLA: we generally aim to issue POs within 3–5 business days after receiving a fully completed vendor form + W-9 + signed SOW. If AtlasCloud needs 7–10 days on your side to set up the vendor record, that’s ok — would you confirm which party issues the PO (you reference issuance "on our side" — are you saying AtlasCloud issues POs to you, or you expect Redwood to issue a PO to AtlasCloud?)

2) Standard Redwood line-item taxonomy we’ll likely use (please confirm these map to your SKU/Contract Item ID):
   - RN-INF-CREDITS — inference token credits (unit: credits)
   - RN-DED-HOURS — dedicated capacity hours (unit: hours)
   - RN-SUPPORT-MONTHLY — managed support fee (unit: month)
   - RN-LICENSE-ANNUAL — enterprise license (unit: year)

We’d like to place the above in this exact field order on the PO: Contract Item ID, SKU (if applicable), Description, Qty, Unit, Unit Price, Start Date, End Date, Cost Center, Total. Is that acceptable?

3) Payment: Net30 is fine. For ACH setup, can AtlasCloud confirm the account holder name matches the legal entity and whether we should collect a voided check?

Action items from Redwood: we will pre-populate the sample_po_template.xlsx with the typical line items above and a placeholder PO number. Priya — can you take point on scheduling the 30-minute review with Mary? Marcus — once Mary confirms bank and W-9 receipt, please mark the vendor as pending-issue in the supplier tracker.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Mary Santos <m.santos@atlascloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AtlasCloud Procurement <procurement@atlascloud.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance for AtlasCloud onboarding

Thanks Dev —

Clarifications: AtlasCloud will be the recipient of the PO (Redwood issues the PO to AtlasCloud). Our earlier "on our side" phrasing meant our accounts team will process invoices after receiving a PO. We can complete vendor setup and return the W-9 + ACH details within 2 business days once the vendor form is received.

The line-item order you proposed is fine; Contract Item ID must be present but we can populate a secondary SKU column if Redwood needs it for internal mapping. ACH account holder matches AtlasCloud, Inc.; we will provide a voided check as part of the vendor form.

We’ll complete and return vendor_onboarding_form.pdf by tomorrow EOD and are available for a 30-minute call on Thu 10/22 at 10:00am PT — will that work for your team?

Mary

—
Mary Santos
VP, Finance Operations | AtlasCloud, Inc.

Attachment stubs: completed_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (to follow), sample_po_template_filled.xlsx (to follow)
